# Yiveno

> Find what you saved from what you remember. Closest fits — you pick.

Yiveno is a Chromium browser extension (Microsoft Edge and Google Chrome) for personal capture and recall. It is not a bookmark manager, notes app, chatbot, or AI organizer as its primary promise. It does not guarantee one correct link; ranked neighborhoods are suggestions.

## Product facts

- Positioning: the one that finds things / Find what you saved
- Capture: save pages or passages with optional personal notes; no folders required
- Recall: type a clue in everyday language; get closest fits in the Side Panel; you decide
- Privacy default: library stays on-device; sign-in does not upload by itself; excerpt cloud sync is opt-in
- We do not sell your collection or use saved content to train public models
- Platforms: Chromium — Edge and Chrome (mainland desktop prefers Edge Add-ons when listed)
- Store status: not yet listed on the public Chrome Web Store or Microsoft Edge Add-ons; no ZIP sideload as the main install path
- Pricing: Free $0 (same on-device find quality); Pro display anchors $7.99/month or $59.99/year USD (excerpt sync + higher cloud clue help). Not a claim of a live public paid customer base
